Paragraph: "Who was a patron of virtue and who himself was a shelterer, to whom Seetha is the daughter-in-law, such a shelterer's son Rama is now taking shelter under Sugreeva...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Emphasizing the dramatic reversal of circumstances that brought Rama to seek refuge.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Contrasting past protective status with present reliance on Sugreeva.
Outcome/Resolution: Deepens the appeal for mutual support.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Kala-mahima (recognition of the shifting power of time/circumstance)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Acknowledging kala-mahima, how time humbles even the mighty to foster interconnectedness.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reflecting on life's unpredictability and the humility it enforces.
